viewer: Car shoppers in 2026 financing about $35,000 over 60 months who are holding off until loan rates come down.
decision: Buy the car now, or wait a year hoping for a lower loan rate?
promise: Using years of bank car-loan rates and new-car prices, we test how often waiting a year actually lowered the monthly payment.
title: Waiting a Year for a Lower Car Loan Rate: Does It Pay Off?
thumbnail: Car key on a wall calendar beside a downward rate arrow / "Wait or buy?"
